title: IREL Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 131 Tradesman Trainee Posts
description: Indian Rare Earths Limited (IREL) has announced the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 131 Tradesman Trainee Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in ITI can use this opportunity and apply for the IREL Notification 2026 . Here, we have included more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
